questions.qtext: Which of the following statement is INCORRECT regarding dry sand moulds?

options.text: Better dimensional accuracy can be achieved.
There is possibility of hot tearing of casting.
They are chance of distortion of the mould.

questions.solution:
(b)
These are the green sand moulds which are completely dried by keeping in an oven between 150 to 350 °C for 8 to 48 hours depending on the binders in the moulding sand. These moulds generally have higher strengths than the green sand mould and are preferred because they are less likely to be damaged during handling. These are generally used for medium to large castings. Better surface finish and dimensional accuracy can be achieved by dry sand mould. The main disadvantages are the likely distortion of the mould caused during the baking process; susceptibility to hot tearing of castings and longer production cycles. Also, this is more expensive than the
green sand mould.

questions.qtext: Which of the following can be expected by introducing group technology in an organisation?

options.text: Improved product quality and low wastage.
Large variety to tools, jigs and fixtures are required.
Space utilisation is more adequately possible.

questions.solution:
(a, c)
Following are the advantages of group technology in manufacturing:
1. Reliable delivery.
2. Reduction of material handling.
3. Use of robots for material handling becomes useful.
4. Space utilisation is more adequately possible.
5. Smaller variety to tools, jigs and fixtures are required.
6. Improved quality of product and less amount of wastage is possible.
7. Improved resource utilisation results in greater amount of output.
8. Finish stock levels are also reduced.

questions.qtext: Which of the following statements relating to the stability of floating as well as submerged bodies is/are correct?

options.text: A submerged body is stable when the center of gravity (G) is below the center of buoyancy (β).
A floating body is stable when the G is above β.
A floating body is stable when G is below the metacenter (M).
A submerged body is in neutral equilibrium when the G coincides with β.

questions.solution:
(a, c, d)
For submerged body,
Stability condition : B above G
Neutral condition : B coincides with G
For floating body
Stability condition : M above G
Neutral condition : M coincides with G
